verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only infrastructure metrics: CPU/memory metrics and telemetry streaming to external tools. That is an adjacent monitoring capability, not built-in analytics for site performance or visitor behavior. Nothing in the pack documents visitor or traffic analytics, page performance tracking, or a web analytics product, so this applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can track site performance and visitor behavior with built-in analytics
